svg.title: Personal AI OS five-layer architecture
svg.desc: A vertical stack of five layers, from the durable portable core at top down to generated and runtime state. Generated publications are disposable; System/Logs is mixed state whose freshness history and obligations must be preserved. A footnote notes the AI is a swappable guest at every layer.
svg.text: Personal AI OS — the five-layer stack

g.text: Your knowledge (00–90 folders) + the System rulebook — plain files you own
80 User — profile, preferences, privacy rules, onboarding state
System — rules, schemas, the 15 operations, scripts, tests (protected)
Per-runtime translation — CLAUDE.md, .obsidian; translate, never own rules
Generated is disposable · Logs is mixed; preserve freshness history & obligations

svg.text: The AI is a guest at every layer. Swap the AI and the folder — your asset — comes with you.
